workspaces.name: The worktree was removed when this was archived, and the branch it stood on is still on the remote, so restoring it cuts a fresh worktree from that branch and leaves the archive exactly as it is, with every chat it held still readable here and nothing at all written back into the project it came from, which is the whole reason this sentence has to be long enough to wrap in any column the window can offer it.
